headlines.headline: STOUDEMIRE, DOC RIVERS, D'ANTONI HEADLINE 2026 HALL OF FAME CLASS ENSHRINED TONIGHT
headlines.detail: The Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame formally enshrines its 2026 class Saturday at 7 PM ET in Springfield, Mass. Six-time All-Star Amar'e Stoudemire is the class's lone NBA player, joined by Bucks coach Doc Rivers, offensive innovator Mike D'Antoni (1,199 career wins, two-time Coach of the Year), Candace Parker and Gonzaga's Mark Few among nine total inductees.

headlines.headline: PRESEASON WEEK 1 WRAPS WITH SEVEN-GAME SATURDAY SLATE; WATSON, SANDERS BOTH PLAY FOR BROWNS
headlines.detail: Saturday's seven-game slate closes out Preseason Week 1, headlined by Cleveland's QB battle between Deshaun Watson and Shedeur Sanders against Chicago and the Cowboys-Seahawks primetime finale at Lumen Field (8 PM ET, NFL Network). New Orleans took a hit Friday when DT Bryan Bresee and G Dillon Radunz both landed on injured reserve with season-ending knee injuries against Jacksonville.

headlines.headline: ALABAMA STILL WITHOUT A STARTING QB AS DEBOER'S CAMP TIMELINE SLIPS
headlines.detail: More than a week into fall camp, Kalen DeBoer has yet to name a starter between redshirt junior Austin Mack and redshirt freshman Keelon Russell, despite hoping for a decision roughly a week and a half in -- a deadline that's now come and gone. Ohio State opens camp as the national title betting favorite with QB Julian Sayin and WR Jeremiah Smith back under new OC Arthur Smith.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL AFTERSHOCKS CONTINUE AS FIFTH-YEAR RULING RESHAPES ROSTERS INTO FALL
headlines.detail: North Carolina guard Seth Trimble is transferring to Louisville, the latest ripple from the federal fifth-year eligibility ruling that triggered a special Aug. 3-10 transfer window. Arizona, Tennessee and Gonzaga are among the programs still rounding out veteran-heavy rosters, and preseason Top 25 projections continue shifting as programs finalize their 15-man rosters heading toward fall practice.
